data.name: Krishnandan
data.long_meaning: Krishnandan is a combination of two Sanskrit words, Krishna and Dan. Krishna means 'God' or 'Black' and Dan means 'wealth' or 'grace'. The name signifies the grace and blessings of Lord Krishna.
data.spiritual_meaning: Krishnandan is a devotional name, representing the deep faith and devotion towards Lord Krishna.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Krishnandan numerologically signifies creativity, love, and harmony.
